name: Health Care
overview: Scripture teaches that caring for the health of others involves compassion and active help, as seen in Deuteronomy 15:7 where God commands not to harden our hearts toward the poor. True healing comes from the Lord, who promises restoration and healing of wounds (Jeremiah 30:17). Wisdom to fear God and avoid evil supports well-being (Proverbs 3:7), while a joyful heart benefits health like medicine (Proverbs 17:22). Jesus acknowledges the need for physicians among the sick, highlighting the importance of care and healing in the community (Matthew 9:12).
